cases.purpose: Positive A1 visual-attention event fi>en: the Finnish numeral-free partitive construction (Tyttö katsoo taloa) maps to the English 'looks at' frame with the partitive theme read as an ordinary singular noun phrase, bare Finnish nouns leave definiteness unspecified (unknown, not definite), the English realization selects determiners by explicit display policy while the definite variant stays an endorsed alternative, and quantity and number survive without loss.

accepted: A girl looks at a house.

required: The girl looks at the house.
